headline: Record revenue and margins on AI-driven equipment demand
summary_short: Applied Materials reported record revenue of $10.41B, up 53% year over year, with non-GAAP EPS of $4.16, up 92%.
summary_long: Gross margin was 50.4% GAAP and 50.6% non-GAAP. Operating income was a record $3.66B. Semiconductor Systems revenue was $8.0B and Applied Global Services $1.9B. Cash from operations was a record $3.30B; the company repurchased $2.0B of stock and paid $421M in dividends. First-quarter fiscal 2027 guidance is revenue of $11.1B plus or minus $500M and non-GAAP EPS of $4.35 plus or minus $0.20.
confidence_notes: Fiscal-label mismatch: the shard labels this event FY2026 Q3, but the release is Applied's fiscal fourth quarter and full year ended Oct. 25, 2026. All figures are from that release; y/y deltas compare with the fiscal Q4 FY2025 column in the release, not the shard's prior-period values. Non-GAAP measures are as defined by the company.

drivers.explanation: The CEO says AI continues to fuel strong incremental demand for semiconductors and that Applied is on track to grow Semiconductor Systems more than 40 percent in calendar 2026.
Semiconductor Systems revenue rose to $7,996M from $4,879M and Applied Global Services to $1,896M from $1,506M, per the segment tables.
